tools.name: search_datasets
tools.title: Search Datasets
tools.description: Search Dewey datasets the user can access by keyword and filters. Returns matching dataset summaries with permissions, categories, data partners, and pagination.

userIntent.description: Brief, task-specific user intent explaining what the user hopes to find. Do not include private notes, hidden chain-of-thought, or sensitive data.

fields.description: Optional top-level fields to include per dataset result. Defaults to a trimmed result shape when omitted. Use `"all"` for the full payload. Nested paths are not supported.

filters.description: Optional search filters. Each field is independently optional and filters can be combined.

region.description: Region filter (case-insensitive exact match against dataset region).

dataProduct.description: The Data Product that owns this Dataset.

tools.name: semantically_search_datasets
tools.title: Semantic Dataset Search
tools.description: Search Dewey datasets the user can access by semantic meaning instead of exact keywords. Returns dataset summaries ranked by semantic relevance, with permissions, categories, data partners, and pagination.

userIntent.description: Brief, task-specific user intent explaining what the user hopes to find. Do not include private notes, hidden chain-of-thought, or sensitive data.

fields.description: Optional top-level fields to include per dataset result. Defaults to a trimmed result shape when omitted. Use `"all"` for the full payload. Nested paths are not supported.

threshold.description: Optional semantic distance threshold. Lower is stricter. Must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

dataProduct.description: The Data Product that owns this Dataset.

tools.name: get_dataset_details
tools.title: Get Dataset Details
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for one Dewey dataset by slug. Defaults to a slim dataset profile and can optionally include team access, supplementary datasets, and fuller column metadata.

projectId.description: Optional project id to scope access messaging.

tools.name: get_dataset_schema
tools.title: Get Dataset Schema
tools.description: Get compact schema metadata for one Dewey dataset by slug. Returns column names, types, descriptions, partition info, and total column count.

tools.name: get_related_datasets
tools.title: Get Related Datasets
tools.description: Get datasets related to one Dewey dataset by slug, including supplementary datasets, sibling datasets in the same data_product, and joinable datasets with labeled join keys.

tools.name: get_download_info
tools.title: Get Download Info
tools.description: Get download-focused metadata for one Dewey dataset by slug, including permissions, file type, row and size estimates, partition range details, customization requirements, and download documentation links.

tools.name: get_dataset_docs
tools.title: Get Dataset Docs
tools.description: Get documentation for one Dewey dataset by slug. Returns partner-level docs first, then dataset-specific docs, with explicit availability statuses when configured docs are missing.

tools.name: get_data_partner_docs
tools.title: Get Data Partner Docs
tools.description: Get documentation for one accessible Dewey data partner by slug, with availability status when documentation is not configured.

tools.name: sample_dataset
tools.title: Sample Dataset
tools.description: Preview sample rows from one Dewey dataset the user can access. Returns structured rows or a CSV string, based on requested format, with optional row-count and column filters.

n.description: Optional max number of sample rows to return. Must be >= 1. Effective max returned rows is min(n, 2000, available sample rows).

format.description: Sample payload format. `json` returns `rows`; `csv` returns `csv`. Defaults to `json`.

columns.description: Optional column names to include in the sample payload. When omitted, all columns are returned.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: List active dataset categories with dataset counts scoped to the requesting user's accessible datasets.

tools.name: list_data_partners
tools.title: List Data Partners
tools.description: List active data partners and their Data Products with per-product dataset counts scoped to the requesting user's accessible datasets.
